mcqs.stem: Which simple epithelium forms endothelial lining in blood vessels to permit nutrient exchange?
mcqs.explanation: Endothelium is simple squamous pavement epithelium.

mcqs.stem: Unicellular mucus-secreting goblet cells interspersed in gut mucosa belong to:
mcqs.explanation: Goblet cells are unicellular columnar glands.

mcqs.stem: Non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium protects moist internal surfaces such as:
mcqs.explanation: Non-keratinized stratified squamous protects moist surfaces.

mcqs.stem: Which primary cell type synthesizes ground substance matrix and collagen fibers in CT proper?
Loose areolar connective tissue performs which physiological role?
options: B) Framing skin and packaging internal viscera
mcqs.answer: B) Framing skin and packaging internal viscera
mcqs.explanation: Areolar tissue frames skin and cushions internal organs.

mcqs.stem: Dense regular white fibrous connective tissue in tendons features parallel bundles of:
options: B) Type I collagen white fibers
mcqs.answer: B) Type I collagen white fibers
mcqs.explanation: Tendons consist of dense regular white collagen bundles.

mcqs.stem: Which solid pliable avascular tissue matrix contains chondrocytes in lacunae spaces?
mcqs.explanation: Cartilage is an avascular solid pliable connective tissue.

Involuntary striated cardiac muscle cells are physically coupled end-to-end by:
options: B) Intercalated discs with gap junctions
mcqs.answer: B) Intercalated discs with gap junctions
mcqs.explanation: Intercalated discs join cardiocytes for syncytium.

msqs.stem: Select all cell junctions involved in epithelial cell attachment: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Epithelial junctions = Tight, Desmosome, Gap, Hemidesmosome.

Select all physiological properties of Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)

msqs.stem: Which anatomical locations contain Hyaline Cartilage? (Select all that apply)
options: A) Articular ends of long bones
answers: A) Articular ends of long bones
msqs.explanation: Hyaline cartilage lines articular ends, nose, ribs, trachea.

msqs.stem: Select all neuroglial support cells residing in the CNS: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: CNS neuroglia = Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes, Microglia, Ependymal. Schwann = PNS.
